name: Auto-Block Correlated Attack
description: Automatically blocks the attacker IP when both Snort signature AND ML anomaly fire for the same source within the correlation window.

name: Review High-Confidence LSTM Anomaly
description: Logs and notifies on a high-confidence LSTM anomaly; a single model alert does not automatically block an IP.

name: Review DNS Tunnel Signal
description: Logs and notifies on a DNS tunneling signal; repeated or corroborated evidence is required before blocking.

name: Threat Score Auto-Quarantine (disabled for medium sensitivity)
description: Disabled because cumulative scores persist and could eventually block a benign source. Correlated or repeated Snort detections remain eligible for automatic response.

name: Repeat High-Severity Snort Block
description: Blocks IP if Snort priority-1 rule fires 3+ times for same IP within 60 seconds.
